01_agenda_and_philosophy.title: Mechanistic Interpretability for AI Safety: A Review

01_agenda_and_philosophy.title: A Pragmatic Vision for Interpretability

01_agenda_and_philosophy.rest: Multi-lab synthesis of attribution-graph and circuit-tracing results; state of the circuits paradigm and its limits
